verdict.rationale: Cursor documents an MCP marketplace for one-click installing third-party MCP servers/tools, plus native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Linear and Automations that trigger cloud agents from these partner platforms' events, letting a lead wire external agent apps into engineering workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of specific partner-built agent apps actually integrated, and more detail on the breadth/curation of the MCP marketplace itself.
